name: api_rcd_approve
_description: POST /api/v1/rcd/approve - mueve un rcd_studies_draft (status='draft') a rcd_studies (status='approved'). Marca el draft como superseded. El tecnico firma aqui.

parameters.query:
WITH ctx AS (
  SELECT set_session_context($2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4) AS ok
),
d AS (
  SELECT s.* FROM rcd_studies_draft s, ctx
  WHERE s.id = $1::uuid AND s.status = 'draft' LIMIT 1
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO rcd_studies (
    project_id, tenant_id, tipo_obra, superficie_m2,
    estimacion_residuos, total_toneladas,
    plan_gestion, gestores_autorizados, coste_gestion_eur,
    alertas_peligrosos, draft_content, status, approved_by, approved_at
  )
  SELECT project_id, tenant_id, tipo_obra, superficie_m2,
         estimacion_residuos, total_toneladas,
         plan_gestion, gestores_autorizados, coste_gestion_eur,
         alertas_peligrosos, draft_content, 'approved', $2::uuid, now()
  FROM d
  RETURNING id, project_id, total_toneladas, approved_at
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE rcd_studies_draft SET status = 'superseded', approved_by = $2::uuid, approved_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'draft'
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT ins.id AS final_id, ins.project_id, ins.total_toneladas, ins.approved_at,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upd) AS draft_marked_superseded
FROM ins
